reading.body:
Google operates a data center campus in Berkeley County, South Carolina, one of its original long-running US sites. The operator does not publish power capacity, square footage, or building-level specifications for individual facilities at this location, disclosing only aggregate state-level investment figures. No individual megawatt figure is available to assess this campus's IT load or rack density.

Google announced a $500 million expansion specific to the Moncks Corner area in 2024 as part of a broader $3.3 billion investment across two South Carolina campuses. The scale of this committed capital suggests material additions to deployed capacity, but the timing and power requirements of these expansions are not published.

This campus has not been assigned a published megawatt figure by this site and therefore cannot be ranked among the four South Carolina facilities with disclosed capacity. Fourteen facilities are mapped in the state. Without operator disclosure of power consumption, this campus cannot be directly compared to peers or used to estimate remaining grid headroom in South Carolina.
